_nota: Liste ufficiali dei Paesi dei servizi digitali, lette da raccolta/servizi.py. stato: si = nella lista con il servizio; no = la fonte nomina il Paese ma senza il servizio (motivo in 'nota'); in_arrivo = Starlink 'Coming soon'; per_regione = Starlink a livello di regione ('exclude'). Paesi assenti = non nominati dalla fonte (mai 'vietato'). Codici ISO 3166-1 alfa-2 (dati/paesi_iso.json).

apple_pay_lista.frase: You can add your credit, debit, or prepaid cards from participating banks and card issuers in these countries and regions:

apple_pay_accettato.frase: Apple Pay is accepted anywhere you see these symbols and marks in stores, within apps, and on the web in Safari and third-party browsers.

apple_pay_cash.frase: Sending and receiving money with Apple Pay and the Apple Cash card are available only in the U.S.

apple_media_lista.frase: Find your country or region below to see what's available to you.

apple_media_varia.frase: Depending on your country or region, you might not be able to buy, download, or subscribe to certain types of media.

youtube_titolo.frase: Premium & Music Premium memberships available locations

youtube_lista.frase: YouTube Premium memberships are available in the countries/territories listed below.

youtube_nota.frase: YouTube paid memberships may not be available in some provinces or territories, even if the governing country/region is listed above.

youtube_paese.frase: Your YouTube Premium membership should be used predominantly in the country where you signed up for it (your subscription country).

youtube_viaggio_no.frase: If you travel to a country where Premium / Premium Lite is not available, you won’t be able to access your membership benefits.

youtube_offline.frase: Any videos that you’ve downloaded before traveling will be available offline for 30 days.

youtube_30.frase: If you are traveling for more than 30 days or move to a different country or territory, we may take action on your subscription, such as cancelling it.

spotify_lista.frase: Check the list below for where you can sign up for Spotify.

spotify_paese.frase: The country or region of your Spotify account is based on where you were when you signed up.

spotify_trasloco.frase: If you've moved, update your account country and payment method to one that's valid where you live now.
